findings.title: Feature-disabled and changed exit codes are not verified for the check command
findings.body: The new test covers only the metadata subcommand and asserts only the error message; it does not assert exit code 4 and does not exercise the check subcommand with rolling-updates disabled. At the same time CompatibilityResult changes RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE from 4 to 3 and reuses 4 for FEATURE_DISABLED, a scripting/operator-facing contract. Without tests asserting 4 for disabled metadata and check, and 3 for an incompatible check result, a regression that returns the wrong code (for example picocli.exit not taking effect or the two codes being swapped) would pass while breaking automation that relies on these codes.

findings.title: Caution overstates that the operator will fail without rolling-updates
findings.body: The added caution says that while in preview the rolling-updates feature must be enabled, otherwise the Keycloak Operator will fail. The PR itself only enables the feature in UpgradeTest when an explicit update strategy is set, and the same section documents the default '<not set>' strategy as supported/mimicking 26.1 behavior. As written, existing users who do not use the new update-strategy feature would read that their operator deployment will fail unless they enable a preview feature, which contradicts the documented default path; the caution should be scoped to when the update strategy / rolling-updates functionality is used.
